title: Users
subtitle: Manage login accounts, roles and group membership
emptyHint: Add a user to assign them a group and a role.
cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete the account you are signed in with
resetNotice: Resetting clears any lock, signs the user out of all sessions, and requires them to change the password on next login.

form.usernameExtra: 3–64 ASCII characters, must start with a letter or digit; letters, digits, ., _ and - are allowed
form.usernamePattern: Only letters, digits, ., _ and - are allowed, starting with a letter or digit
form.roleExtra: Admins can access the admin console; regular users only see the user console
form.groupExtra: Every user belongs to exactly one group, which defines concurrency and token quota
form.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
form.noteMax: Note must be at most 255 characters
